question_cn: 己方兵推进到第7排（升变前一格）的主要价值是：
question_en: Advancing a pawn to the 7th rank (one step from promotion) creates immediate value because:

options.text_cn: 立即形成升变威胁，迫使对方王必须去处理，无法兼顾其他
options.text_en: Creates immediate promotion threat, forcing enemy king to deal with it and leaving other pawns unguarded
The pawn is harder to capture on the 7th rank
A pawn on the 7th rank promotes automatically

options.text_cn: 第7排的兵能保护更多格子
options.text_en: A 7th rank pawn protects more squares

explanation_cn: 七线兵是兵残局最强的牵制武器：迫使对方王必须去拦截，制造其他地方的突破机会。'威胁即力量'——这是多兵优势转化为胜势的关键手段。
explanation_en: 7th rank pawn is the ultimate diversion: forces the enemy king to deal with it, opening breakthrough opportunities elsewhere — 'the threat is stronger than its execution'.
